info.text:
Free Google Search brought in $224.5 billion in 2025.

That's Google's Search & other revenue in Alphabet's 2025 annual report, about $615 million a day.
Advertisers bid to show ads next to your search, often paying per click.
April to June 2026: Search & other rose 17% to $63.3 billion.
Google paid Apple about $20 billion in 2022 to be Safari's default search engine.
A September 2025 ruling barred exclusive deals. The ruling is under appeal.

Sources: Alphabet 2025 Form 10-K, Alphabet Q2 2026 results, US v. Google court records.
News and education, not financial advice.
